summary: M01.B Appointments + Waitlist + Reminders sprint validated. Backend: 21/21 pytest pass — covers create/list/update/cancel/slots/double-booking 409/services, waitlist add/list/promote/invalid status, reminder stub email+whatsapp dispatch and log retrieval, auth gating on all 3 routers, no _id leak. Frontend: AppointmentsPage loads at /frontdesk/appointments, Today/Week toggle works, prev/next/today nav works, all 3 filters present (audiologist/service/priority), Book Appointment modal opens with full form (patient search, audiologist dropdown, date/time picker, free-slot suggestion chips, service, duration, room, priority, notes, Cancel/Book buttons), WaitlistPanel slides over with Add-to-waitlist form and live empty state. One existing 'Vikram Singh' appointment renders correctly with status chip, status dropdown, WA/SMS reminder buttons, Edit, and Cancel (✕). All data-testids per AppointmentsPage.js confirmed in DOM.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in FrontDeskModule (likely a styled <span> nested inside a <select><option> somewhere in the appointments toolbar). Cosmetic but should be fixed to silence hydration error.

No dedicated 'Email' reminder button on appointment cards — only WA + SMS rendered (Email channel works on backend; UI exposes only 2 of 3 channels). Consider adding an Email button or a unified 'Send reminder' menu.
Status filter is referenced in spec but not present in toolbar (only audiologist/service/priority). Backend supports ?status=… filter — UI gap.

action_items: Fix hydration warning: locate <span> inside <option> in AppointmentsPage / AppShell topbar select and replace with plain text or a dot prefix.
Add Email reminder button on ApptCard alongside WA + SMS so all 3 backend channels are exposed.
Add a status filter <select> to the appointments toolbar (status= already supported by GET /api/appointments).

(Optional) Surface the 409 conflict_with details inline rather than as a generic alert() — currently reschedule failure shows a JS alert with the conflict message, which is functional but not graceful.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _overlap_query EXCLUDES status 'completed' from conflict checks (line 268). This means a completed appointment's slot is reusable — semantically OK for past appointments but could allow odd edge cases if a same-day appointment is marked completed early; document the intent.
server.py update_appointment uses payload: dict — bypasses Pydantic validation. Consider an AppointmentUpdate model so unknown keys are rejected and types coerced.
AppointmentsPage.js onDrop / onCancel use window.alert() / window.prompt() — fine for MVP but should move to toast + confirm dialog before production.

reminders.py: the 'else' branch (provider configured but no SDK wired) marks status='sent' though no real send happens. This is misleading — once provider keys exist but SDK is not implemented, logs will say 'sent' falsely. Recommend keeping 'stubbed_no_provider_key' until real SDK call is in place, or introduce a 'sdk_not_implemented' status.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows render; minor UX gaps: status filter + email button + alert() UX)
